rationale_summary: The guideline is dominantly framed around innovation_enablement: it explicitly positions governance rules as 'guardrails for promoting the utilization of generative AI' to advance adoption and risk management as 'two sides of the same coin,' accelerate a virtuous cycle of innovation, modernize public administration, and ensure proportional risk-balanced controls so that even high-risk innovative projects can proceed safely. Innovation enablement edges out fundamental_rights, economic_competitiveness, and consumer_public_safety because those goals are integrated as supporting objectives or risk-boundary conditions within an overarching mission to drive safe, effective public-sector AI adoption. Secondary frames are nonetheless substantive: fundamental_rights anchors the purpose in Japan's Human-Centric AI Society Principles (dignity, diversity and inclusion) and privacy/non-discrimination protections; economic_competitiveness justifies leading-by-example government adoption and public procurement to boost Japan's international AI competitiveness and foster domestic startups; and consumer_public_safety underpins high-risk classifications targeting harms to human life, body, property, and citizen safety. Social_stability (disinformation, political neutrality) and national_security (foreign server jurisdiction concerns) appear only peripherally, and systems handling national security or public order are explicitly excluded from the guideline's scope.

evidence_spans.quote: 生成AI を含むAI の様々なリスクを抑え、安全・安心な環境を確保しつつ、イノベーションを加速する好循環の形成を図っていくこととされ、イノベーション推進のためにも、ガードレールとなるAI 利活用の安全・安心を確保するためのルールが必要とされたところである。
evidence_spans.quote_en: It was decided to form a virtuous cycle that accelerates innovation while curbing various risks of AI, including generative AI, and ensuring a safe and secure environment; to promote innovation as well, rules that serve as guardrails to ensure the safety and security of AI utilization were deemed necessary.

evidence_spans.quote: 本ガイドラインは、生成AI の利活用促進のためのガードレールであり、本ガイドラインによって、政府による生成AI の安心・安全な利活用が着実に進展し、 以下のような利益を実現することを目指す。
evidence_spans.source_section: Page 8 (2.1 本ガイドラインの目的)
evidence_spans.quote_en: This guideline serves as a guardrail for promoting the utilization of generative AI, and through this guideline, aims to steadily advance the safe and secure utilization of generative AI by the government and realize the following benefits.

evidence_spans.quote_en: In addition, in order to promote the safe and secure use of AI across society as a whole and improve Japan's international competitiveness in the field of AI, it is extremely important for the government to take the initiative in utilizing AI.

evidence_spans.quote_en: Utilizing 'public procurement' is important for fostering startups such as domestic generative AI businesses.

evidence_spans.source_section: Page 8 (2.1 本ガイドラインの目的)
evidence_spans.quote_en: In the procurement and utilization of generative AI by the government, this guideline aims to realize the three 'basic philosophies' set forth in the 'Social Principles of Human-Centric AI' formulated by Japan in March 2019: '(1) a society where human dignity is respected (Dignity),' '(2) a society where people with diverse backgrounds can pursue diverse well-being (Diversity and Inclusion),' and '(3) a sustainable society (Sustainability).'
